paragraphs.en: The Cowardly Lion woke up after lying among poppies for a long time. He was glad to still be alive when he opened his eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 胆小狮在罂粟花丛中躺了许久后醒了过来，睁开眼时还高兴自己竟然还能活着。

paragraphs.en: "I ran as fast as I could," he said, sitting down and yawning, "but the flowers were too strong for me. How did you get me out?"
paragraphs.zh: “我使出全力跑了过来，”他一边坐下打了个哈欠一边说，“可是那些花的力量太强了。你是怎么把我弄出来的？”

paragraphs.en: They told him about the field mice who saved him from death. The Lion laughed, saying that he had always thought himself big and terrible, yet small things nearly killed him.
paragraphs.zh: 他们告诉他，是田鼠救了他一命。狮子笑着说，自己一直以为自己庞大而可怕，没想到一些微不足道的小事差点要了他的命。

paragraphs.en: "We must journey on until we find the road of yellow brick," said Dorothy. They started walking through soft grass, enjoying their trip. Soon they reached the yellow-bricked road and turned toward the Emerald City.
paragraphs.zh: “我们必须继续前行，直到找到那条黄砖路。”多萝西说道。他们踏着柔软的草地行走，享受着这段旅程。很快，他们便来到了那条黄砖路上，并朝翡翠城的方向走去。

paragraphs.en: The road was smooth and well-paved, with green fences and houses along it. People were afraid to approach them because of the Lion, who was dressed in emerald-green clothing. Dorothy said this must be the Land of Oz, getting closer to the Emerald City.
paragraphs.zh: 这条路平整而铺砌良好，两旁绿树成荫，房屋错落有致。人们因为那只身着翠绿色服装的狮子而不敢靠近。多萝西说这一定是奥兹国，正逐渐接近翡翠城。

paragraphs.en: "Yes," answered the Scarecrow. "Everything is green here, while blue was favored by Munchkins. But people seem less friendly, and we may not find a place to stay for the night."
paragraphs.zh: “是的，”稻草人回答说，“这里的颜色都是绿色的，而 munchkins 偏爱蓝色。不过人们似乎不太友好，我们可能找不到过夜的地方。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy said, "I want something to eat besides fruit, and Toto is nearly starved. Let's stop at the next house."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西说：“除了水果，我还想吃点别的东西。托托也快饿坏了。我们去下一户人家看看吧。”

paragraphs.en: They approached a farmhouse, and Dorothy knocked boldly on the door. A woman opened it slightly and asked, "What do you want, child? And why is that great Lion with you?"
paragraphs.zh: 她们走近一所农舍，多萝西大胆地敲了敲门。一位妇女微微打开门缝，问道：“你们是谁？孩子，你为什么要带着那只巨大的狮子？”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy replied, "We wish to stay for the night if you allow us. The Lion is my friend and would not hurt anyone."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西回答说：“如果您允许的话，我们想在这里过一夜。狮子是我的朋友，他不会伤害任何人。”

paragraphs.en: The woman asked, "Is he tame?" Opening the door wider, she added, "He will be more afraid of you than you are of him."
paragraphs.zh: 女人问道：“他温顺吗？”她拉开门缝，又补充了一句：“他会比你更怕你。”

paragraphs.en: After some thought, the woman said, "You may come in. I'll give you supper and a place to sleep." They entered the house, where two children and a man with a hurt leg lay on a couch.
paragraphs.zh: 经过一番思考，那名女子说道：“你可以进来。我给你准备晚饭和一个睡觉的地方。”他们走进了房子，只见沙发上躺着两个孩子和一名腿有伤的男人。

paragraphs.en: The man asked, "Where are you all going?"
paragraphs.zh: 那人问道：“你们要去哪儿？”

paragraphs.en: "To the Emerald City," Dorothy answered, "to see the Great Oz."
paragraphs.zh: “去翡翠城，”多萝西回答，“去看大奥兹。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, indeed!" exclaimed the man. "Are you sure he will see you?"
paragraphs.zh: “哦，确实如此！”那人脱口而出，“你确定他会见你吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Why not?" she replied.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么不呢？”她回答道。

paragraphs.en: He explained, "It is said that he never lets anyone into his presence. I've been to the Emerald City many times, but have never seen the Great Oz."
paragraphs.zh: 他解释道：“据说他从不让人进入他的居所。我多次去过翡翠城，却从未见过大巫师奥兹。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow asked, "Does he never go out?"
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人问道：“他从不出门吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No," the man said. "He sits in his Throne Room day after day, and even those who serve him do not see him face to face."
paragraphs.zh: “不，”那人说道，“他日复一日地坐在王座室内，就连服侍他的人都难得见到他一面。”

paragraphs.en: "What is he like?" Dorothy inquired.
paragraphs.zh: “他是个什么样的人？”多萝西问道。

paragraphs.en: The man thoughtfully replied, "It's hard to say. Oz can take any form he wishes—some say a bird, others an elephant or cat. He appears as a fairy or brownie, depending on his mood.
paragraphs.zh: 那人沉思着回答道：“说不准呢。奥兹可以随心所欲地变化形态——有人说他像鸟，也有人说他是大象或猫。他的模样会根据心情而不同，有时像是仙子或是棕色精灵。”

paragraphs.en: No one knows what the real Oz looks like."
paragraphs.zh: 没有人真正知道奥兹国国王究竟是什么模样。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy said, "This is strange, but we must try to see him. We need his help."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西说：“这有点奇怪，但我们必须试着见见他。我们需要他的帮助。”

paragraphs.en: "Why do you want to see Oz?" asked the man.
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么想见奥兹？”那人问道。

paragraphs.en: "I need brains," said the Scarecrow eagerly.
paragraphs.zh: “我需要智慧。”稻草人急切地说。

paragraphs.en: "Oz has plenty of those," replied the man. "He has more than he can use."
paragraphs.zh: “奥兹有的是那种人，”那人回答，“他多得用不完。”

paragraphs.en: "And I need a heart," said the Tin Woodman.
paragraphs.zh: “我需要一颗心。”铁皮人说道。

paragraphs.en: "That won't be hard for him," continued the man, "as he keeps many hearts in his collection."
paragraphs.zh: “这对他来说并不难，”那人继续说道，“因为他收藏了许多颗心。”

paragraphs.en: "I want courage," said the Cowardly Lion.
paragraphs.zh: “我想要勇气。”胆小的狮子说道。

paragraphs.en: "Oz has a pot of courage in his Throne Room," explained the man. "He'll give you some if you ask."
paragraphs.zh: “奥兹王的宝座室内有一罐勇气，”那人解释道，“如果你请求的话，他会给你一些。”

paragraphs.en: "And I need to go back to Kansas," said Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: “我得回堪萨斯去。”多萝西说道。

paragraphs.en: "Where is Kansas?" asked the man, surprised.
paragraphs.zh: “堪萨斯在哪里？”那人惊讶地问道。

paragraphs.en: "I don't know," replied Dorothy sadly. "But it's my home."
paragraphs.zh: “我不知道，”多萝西悲伤地回答，“但这里是我的家。”

paragraphs.en: "Oz can find it for you," said the man. They set off soon after, and saw a green glow in the sky ahead.
paragraphs.zh: “奥兹可以帮你找到它。”那人说道。他们不久便启程，只见前方天空中泛着一抹绿色的光芒。

paragraphs.en: "That must be the Emerald City," said Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: “那一定是翡翠城。”多萝西说道。

paragraphs.en: As they approached, the green glow intensified, signaling their nearing destination. By afternoon, they reached the towering emerald wall surrounding the city.
paragraphs.zh: 随着他们接近，绿色的光芒逐渐增强，预示着他们的目的地越来越近。到了下午，他们终于抵达了围绕城市的那道高耸的翡翠色城墙。

paragraphs.en: At the end of the yellow-brick road stood a grand gate adorned with glittering emeralds. Dorothy pressed the bell, and a silvery tinkle echoed inside. The gate slowly opened, revealing a high-arched room lined with countless emeralds.
paragraphs.zh: 在黄砖路的尽头，矗立着一扇华丽的大门，门上镶嵌着闪烁的祖母绿。多萝西按了门铃，一阵银铃般的响声从里面传来。大门缓缓开启，露出一间高拱顶的房间，四壁密布着无数璀璨的祖母绿。

paragraphs.en: A small man, dressed entirely in green, appeared before them. He sat down to ponder their request. "Why do you seek the Great Oz?"
paragraphs.zh: 一个全身穿着绿色衣服的小个子男人突然出现在他们面前。他坐下来沉思着他们的请求。“你们为什么要找奥兹大王？”

paragraphs.en: he asked.
paragraphs.zh: 他问道。

paragraphs.en: "We wish to see him," Dorothy replied.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西回答说：“我们想见他。”

paragraphs.en: The man was surprised and took time to consider. "Few have ever dared ask to meet Oz," he said, shaking his head. "He is powerful and might destroy you if you disturb his wisdom."
paragraphs.zh: 那人惊讶之余，沉思片刻后说道：“很少有人敢请求见奥兹。”他摇了摇头，“他实力强大，如果你打扰了他的智慧，可能会把你毁掉。”

paragraphs.en: "But our mission is important," the Scarecrow argued. "We've been told Oz is a good Wizard."
paragraphs.zh: “但我们肩负的重要使命不容忽视，”稻草人争辩道，“我们被告知奥兹是一个好巫师。”

paragraphs.en: "Indeed, he is wise and just," the man confirmed. "But few are honest enough to approach him. I am the Guardian of the Gates.
paragraphs.zh: “他确实智慧公正，”那人确认道，“但很少有人诚实到敢接近他。我是守门者。”

paragraphs.en: You must wear these spectacles first." He pointed to a large green box beside him.
paragraphs.zh: 你必须先戴上这些眼镜。“他指着旁边的一个大绿色盒子说道。

paragraphs.en: "Why do we need them?" Dorothy inquired.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么要让他们参与进来？”多萝西问道。

paragraphs.en: "To protect you from the city's brilliance," he explained. "The Emerald City’s light would blind you without them. Even residents must wear them constantly, as Oz decreed when the city was built.
paragraphs.zh: “为了防止你被城市的光辉所伤，”他解释道，“没有这些护目镜，Emerald City 的光芒会刺瞎你的眼睛。即使是居民也必须一直佩戴它们，奥兹在建造这座城市时就做出了这样的规定。”

paragraphs.en: I hold the only key that can unlock them."
paragraphs.zh: “我握有唯一能开启它们的钥匙。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy found the box contained various-sized green-tinted glasses. The Guardian of the Gate chose a pair for her, securing them with golden bands locked by a key around his neck. Dorothy couldn't remove them, but she didn't mind, as she was grateful not to be blinded by the Emerald City's brightness.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西发现盒子里装着各种大小的绿边眼镜。守门者为自己挑选了一副，用金色的环锁住，这些金环由他脖子上的钥匙固定。多萝西无法取下眼镜，但她并不介意，因为她感激自己不会被翡翠城的光芒刺瞎眼睛。

paragraphs.en: The Guardian then fitted similar glasses on the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, Lion, and even Toto. He put on his own pair and led them towards the Palace, taking a golden key from the wall. Opening another gate, they entered the streets of the Emerald City together.
paragraphs.zh: 守门人随后给稻草人、铁皮人和狮子戴上类似的墨镜，甚至也给托托戴了一副。他自己也戴上一副，然后领着他们朝宫殿走去，从墙上取下一把金钥匙。打开另一扇门后，他们一起进入了翡翠城的街道。
